title: Moxie Magnet Moon
description: Moxie the axolotl salvager has a magnetic backpack! Move with the stick; A/Space snaps 58 pixels in your last direction and pulls all nearby stardust into a combo. Recharge between bursts, dodge dust bunnies, bank 30 points before 45 seconds. Fast wins earn bonus points. B skips a ready dash to fire a stationary pulse. Progress auto-saves.
